**Description**: The optimized candidate generated by the trainer agent as the manual-followup inference step, then refined with the teacher's pytest qualification suggestion. Addresses all six engineer-identified weaknesses.

**Key changes from original**:
1. Explicit evidence reading order (STEERING.md → summary → optimize output → context)
2. Observable teacher handoff trigger (no STEERING.md, or STEERING.md predates optimize output)

5. Approval prediction grounded in per-item checklist from latest STEERING.md
6. Loop-cap no-op added (revision 3+ with no approval signal)

**Expected judge assessment**: Scores higher on all six dimensions identified in the review. Teacher approved with high confidence.
